newsitem.title: CHINA: CNAC, DRAGONAIR TO INVEST US$180 MLN IN HK SITE.
newsitem.headline: CNAC, DRAGONAIR TO INVEST US$180 MLN IN HK SITE.

text.p: China National Aviation Corp and Hong Kong Dragon Airlines Ltd (Dragonair) will invest HK$1.4 billion in the development of an office building at Hong Kong's future new airport, the Airport Authority said on Thursday.
"The cost of investment by CNAC and Dragonair will be about HK$1.4 billion," the Authority said in a statement.
Dragonair said its total investment in the construction of its new office is estimated to be HK$900 million.

The building will feature two six-storey office towers, one for each company. The Dragonair tower with about 20,600 sq metres in gross floor area will house the airline's headquarters, Dragonair said.
Dragonair, China's state owned CNAC and the Airport Authority signed an agreement on the development on Thursday.
CNAC is Dragonair's largest single shareholder with a 35.86 percent holding. Swire Pacific Ltd and Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd together hold 26 percent of Dragonair.
The new Chek Lap Kok airport is due to open next April.
